capabilities: Arrange scenes by act, subplot, and narrative or chronological order in a radial layout
Track writing progress and revision stages across four timelines
Display scenes in a Bases timetable and Canvas subplot lanes
Share scenes with readers through the Radial Timeline Community
Export manuscripts to Word or PDF via Pandoc templates
disambiguation: Not a general timeline or project manager; it maps fiction scenes, acts, and subplots for longform writing projects.
extras: Desktop-only; source-available non-commercial license, patent pending; AI features ship off by default; how-to docs live externally; optimal on ~200 ppi displays.
problem: Writers lose sight of how subplots interweave when scrolling through spreadsheet tables and files; Obsidian offers no structural map of a manuscript.

relations.evidence: Radial Timeline and its companion plugin, Editorialist, feature by feature.
Shell execution and Direct filesystem access are used for Pandoc manuscript publishing.

summary: Radial timeline visualizer for longform writing that arranges scenes by act, subplot, and narrative or chronological order.
